response_text:
I cannot complete this task as requested because the current claim text is not available in the application materials provided. The section labeled "Current claims (pre-amendment)" states "(no claim text available)."

To draft amended claims that address the §101 and §103 rejections, I require:

1. The full text of claims 1-13 (the rejected independent and dependent claims)
2. The complete specification/disclosure to ensure any amendments do not introduce new matter
3. The full text of the Tobin reference cited in the §103 rejection

Without the original claim language, I cannot apply the amendment principles of modifying only necessary limitations while preserving scope and ensuring all added language is supported by the specification.

Please provide:
- The complete text of claims 1-13 as originally filed
- Relevant portions of the specification describing the invention
- The complete Tobin reference or its key teachings

Once these materials are available, I can draft appropriate amendments to overcome the §101 abstract idea rejection and the §103 obviousness rejection over Tobin.
